audit_finding.description: The frozen generic Candidate-B comparison adapter classifies a Stage-2 rejection as PROPOSITION_CONSTRUCTION only when the exception text contains the word proposition. The six Stage-2 exceptions below arise directly from Proposition validation but name the proposition subtype instead, so the generated comparison records label them RELATIONSHIP_SEMANTICS. Those generated records remain byte-preserved; this audit supplies the authoritative SPEC-046 taxonomy classification.
